item.title: Larsen & Toubro secures mega offshore EPC order worth Rs 4,200 crore from ONGC for Mumbai High
item.description: Larsen & Toubro's hydrocarbon business has bagged a substantial offshore engineering, procurement and construction contract from ONGC for offshore platform topsides and subsea pipelines in the Mumbai High western offshore basin.

item.title: Oil India signs offshore exploration agreement with international seismic contractor for Andaman basin
item.description: Oil India Limited has entered into a comprehensive agreement for high-resolution 3D Ocean Bottom Node seismic survey covering deepwater exploration acreage in the Andaman offshore basin.

item.title: Automobile manufacturers report festive sales surge in passenger car segment
item.description: Leading auto manufacturers recorded robust domestic deliveries during the opening week of festive auto sales.
